name: FUCUO Elements
author: fucuo

sections.description:
FUCUO Elements adds sixteen independently enabled Elementor widgets: a PDF library,
3D slideshow, page showcase, category panels, horizontal timeline, linked slider,
scroll reveal, scroll process, hero slideshow, horizontal case carousel, responsive accordion, cinematic card slideshow, WhatsApp inquiry button, nested hover card, nested hover tabs and collapsible WooCommerce taxonomy navigation. Elementor is required.
The WhatsApp widget also requires WooCommerce for product context.
Bundled demonstration images are original geometric placeholders.

External services

The optional WhatsApp inquiry widget opens https://wa.me/ when the visitor chooses
to continue. The configured recipient number, current product information and
completed form answers are passed in the link to WhatsApp (Meta). The visitor must
confirm Send in WhatsApp. This widget does not store form answers in WordPress
or send them to the plugin developer. No WhatsApp request is made just by opening
the inquiry form or editing the widget preview.
Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

Privacy

The optional PDF viewing and download form stores the configured contact fields,
publication, consent and submission/download times in the site database.
It does not send these details to the plugin developer. Administrators should
publish a privacy policy and determine a retention period. There is no automatic
lead deletion. WordPress Tools > Export/Erase Personal Data supports these records,
even with the PDF module switched off while this plugin remains active.
A hashed IP rate-limit key expires after ten minutes; download tokens expire after
fifteen minutes. Expired entries may persist until cache cleanup.
Deleting the plugin does not automatically remove saved pages or PDF records.
Media-library PDF URLs are public; the form is not a file protection system.

Source and licenses

All scripts are bundled locally; no external updater or license server is included.
Source and build references:
* PDF.js 6.4.299 source and build instructions.
* StPageFlip 2.0.7: the patched TypeScript and runtime reproduction instructions are bundled in modules/alai-pdf-library/assets/vendor/page-flip.
See SOURCES.txt for additional source and license details. All bundled demo JPEGs were replaced with original geometric
placeholders in 1.1.5, licensed GPL-3.0-or-later.
sections.installation:
If upgrading from laowang-elementor-kit, deactivate that plugin before activating
fucuo-elements. Existing widget IDs and settings are retained. Do not activate both.

先安装并启用 Elementor。上传本 ZIP 并启用，在后台「FUCUO 组件库」保存组件开关。
已有独立插件请先停用；保留原组件 ID，无需重新创建页面。
完整中文使用说明见「usage-guide.txt」。
更新后清除页面及 CDN 缓存，以替换引用旧资源的缓存 HTML。
sections.faq:
关闭组件会怎样？

不注册或加载该模块，编辑器与前台停止显示，原设置保留。重新开启后可恢复。

原独立插件可以同时启用吗？

不建议。检测到冲突时合集跳过对应模块并提示停用原插件。

PDF 下载表单能保证文件保密吗？

不能。在线阅读使用公开媒体库地址。下载表单仅作资料收集与下载引导。
sections.changelog:
1.1.60

  • Consolidate the PDF request form editor in Elementor and organize widget controls by the element they affect.

1.1.59

  • Edit shared PDF request fields and styles inside Elementor and preview either popup without submitting a customer record.

1.1.58

  • Organize PDF library controls by region and layout; keep existing typography, palette and responsive settings as fallbacks.

1.1.57

  • Slim down the default PDF library search field and add separate Elementor styling for the search field and header background, image and corners.

1.1.56

  • Share a centered title, introduction, search field and publication statistics across download center and cover layouts.

1.1.55

  • Simplify Download Center search to a single field with an inset search icon and live filtering.

1.1.54

  • Display PDF request fields immediately while preparing submission in the background, including on product pages.

1.1.53

  • Configure PDF lead form fields, typography and button colors. Preserve submitted field labels and values in lead details and CSV exports.

1.1.52

  • Add an administrator switch to require contact details before document previews and downloads, including product PDF links.

1.1.51

  • Add normal and hover colors for product PDF buttons and improve automatic left/right placement on dynamic product forms.

1.1.50

  • Set the download center sidebar width and associate library PDFs with WooCommerce products. Add a document button automatically or with [fucuo_product_downloads].

1.1.49

  • Add theme-aware and customizable download center buttons and optional document category labels with an uncategorized fallback.

1.1.48

  • Add a cover-free download center layout with nested category filters, search, paging and a mobile filter drawer.

1.1.47

  • Add an optional native PDF reader to the PDF library. Existing libraries default to the 3D flipbook. Browser PDF controls may allow direct saving.

1.1.46

  • Integrate FUCUO Product Category Navigation 1.6.2 for Elementor and WordPress widget areas.

1.1.45

  • Integrate FUCUO Hover Tabs 0.1.7 with its existing widget ID, settings, nested content and menu interaction behavior.

1.1.44

  • Add the nested two-sided hover card with 15 transitions, editable faces and touch controls. Preserve standalone widget IDs, settings, and children. Enable the module before deactivating the standalone card plugin.

1.1.43

  • Add a responsive navigation right inset, defaulting to 50px, while retaining first-card arrow alignment and first-paint positioning.
  • Preserve preview card text colors against theme hover styles; add a separate hover/focus color control.

1.1.42

  • Add fixed-height horizontal scrolling to Scroll Process while retaining the original growth mode; isolate mode initialization and stale-cache compatibility.
  • Integrate the cinematic card slideshow; resolve stage height and first-paint edge alignment, keep navigation aligned with the first visible card, and preserve deferred images and offscreen pause.
  • Improve WhatsApp entry-button styling and editor form-preview control; inherit native theme defaults and render paired WoodMart variable-product buttons in one row before scripts load.
  • Preserve existing widget IDs, saved settings, PDF records, shortcodes and module switches. Existing installations enable new modules manually.
  • Remove unused superseded runtime assets and unrelated test-package notes; consolidate current usage instructions and retain third-party source/license files.
  • Earlier release history is available in changelog.txt.
